items.title: Harry Potter (Saga)
items.author: J. K. Rowling
items.description: The movies already mean so much to me — the full collection is bought and sitting on my shelf, waiting for the right moment to dive in.

items.title: Divergent
items.author: Veronica Roth
items.description: Tris is what makes this saga work. The worldbuilding is interesting, but it's her arc that kept me turning pages all the way to a genuinely satisfying ending.

items.title: The Hunger Games
items.author: Suzanne Collins
items.description: A defining piece of my teenage years. The films pulled me in, the books kept me — both are incredible in their own right.

items.title: Dracula
items.author: Bram Stoker
items.description: The kind of classic that earns its reputation. The gothic atmosphere grabs you from the first page and never lets go.

items.author: George Orwell
items.description: Essential reading for our generation. Every page reads like a mirror held up to the present, and it stays with you long after the last chapter.
